desc: Derive the exact contribution formula for a fixed distinguished number \(i\), including the subset-after-\(i\) count and positional power of 10.
Group \(1,\ldots,N\) by decimal digit length and derive coefficients for subsets after a fixed element.
Design an \(O(N\cdot D)\) dynamic program for the six possible excluded digit lengths.
Precompute factorials and combine each digit-length group’s coefficient sum with its sum of values modulo 998244353.
Implement input/output and verify edge cases such as \(N=1\), while keeping memory within limits.
